# ceil2f

> Round a numeric value to the nearest power of two toward positive infinity.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var ceil2f = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/ceil2' );
```

#### ceil2f( x )

Rounds a `numeric` value to the nearest power of two toward positive infinity.

```javascript
var v = ceil2f( -4.2 );
// returns -4.0

v = ceil2f( -4.5 );
// returns -4.0

v = ceil2f( -4.6 );
// returns -4.0

v = ceil2f( 9.99999 );
// returns 16.0

v = ceil2f( 9.5 );
// returns 16.0

v = ceil2f( 13.0 );
// returns 16.0

v = ceil2f( -13.0 );
// returns -8.0

v = ceil2f( 0.0 );
// returns 0.0

v = ceil2f( -0.0 );
// returns -0.0

v = ceil2f( Infinity );
// returns Infinity

v = ceil2f( -Infinity );
// returns -Infinity

v = ceil2f( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var randu = require( '@stdlib/random/base/randu' );
var ceil2f = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/ceil2f' );

var x;
var v;
var i;

for ( i = 0; i < 100; i++ ) {
    x = (randu()*100.0) - 50.0;
    v = ceil2f( x );
    console.log( 'x: %d. Rounded: %d.', x, v );
}
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/ceil2f.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_ceil2f( x )

Rounds a `numeric` value to the nearest power of two toward positive infinity.

```c
double y = stdlib_base_ceil2f( 3.14f );
// returns 4.0f
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] float` input value.

```c
float stdlib_base_ceil2f( const float x );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

</section>

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/ceil2f.h"
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    const float x[] = { 3.14f, -3.14f, 0.5f, 0.0f/0.0f };

    float y;
    int i;
    for ( i = 0; i < 4; i++ ) {
        y = stdlib_base_ceil2f( x[ i ] );
        printf( "ceil2f(%f) = %f\n", x[ i ], y );
    }
}
```

</section>
